description: This file defines a wizard for tracking and splitting stock move lines in an Odoo (OpenERP) module related to manufacturing resource planning (MRP). It includes form definitions, validation, and logic for creating production lots and updating stock moves.

classes.name: wizard_track_move
classes.description: A wizard interface for tracking and splitting stock moves in manufacturing.

methods.name: _check_picking
methods.description: Validates that the stock move or its production order has an associated picking before splitting.

methods.name: _track_lines
methods.description: Creates production lots, updates stock move quantities, and links move lines to production orders based on user input.
